LESSON: BELIEF IN HIS

Grade: PP1
Subject: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Strand: Strand 2
Topic 2.2: Belief in His

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! This is a study lesson on Belief in His. Read the explanation, follow every worked example, then do the practice. This is original CBC Learn content written from KICD outcomes — not a copy of a commercial textbook.

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. Explain the main ideas in Belief in His
2. Give Kenyan examples for Belief in His
3. Practise Belief in His at school and at home

Example 2: Give a home/community example from your county.
